source.name: Chapter 6: 6.1 Knowledge Check - action server vs. mcp server
source.instructions: **What is the key difference between the action server and the MCP server?**

answers.answer: The MCP server replaces the action server in Level 6
The MCP server runs Rasa flows; the action server handles sub-agents
The action server is called by the flow at a defined step; the MCP server exposes tools the sub-agent's LLM calls during reasoning
Both serve the same purpose but use different ports

source.learningObjectives: SWBAT describe main difference between custom action server and the mcp server
source.guidance: The flow controls when the action server runs in the order defined, the LLM controls when MCP tools run, multiple calls, in any order, until the task is done.
